terminals.name: worker-api
terminals.description: Cloudflare Worker API (Hono) on http://localhost:8787. Runs fully local: --local disables remote-only bindings (Workers AI has no local emulator and would otherwise require CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN); --enable-containers=false skips the PDF/OCR container images that need Docker.

terminals.name: client-web
terminals.description: React SPA (Vite) on http://localhost:5173. Proxies /api and /ws to the Worker on :8787. Local dev login: devadmin / DevPass123!
